stem: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be acute angles. Which of the following must be true? ( )

form: α, β acute: which statement must be true

stem: If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are both acute angles, which of the following always holds? ( )

form: α, β acute: which statement must be true
